referenceSources.description:
A white 1990 Subaru Legacy RS Type RA is photographed on a grassy field at dusk, its gold alloy wheels and black roof contrasting against the muted sky. The handcrafted STI tuning badge on the side and the roof antenna mark its competition-grade pedigree. 

Introduced in December 1989 as a limited-production model, the RS Type RA built on the RS Type R’s EJ20 turbocharged engine with port polishing, balanced internals, and reinforced rods and pistons. It also featured a variable-quick power steering, strengthened suspension tuned for low-μ surfaces, and four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, making it ready for rally competition straight from the factory.
